mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate cash flows, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met, or when FEDFUNDS > 5% but inflation is simultaneously rising faster than wage growth.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST < previous 12-month average for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the GDP and housing weakness reverses within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% for three consecutive months, in the absence of offsetting wage growth (PAYEMS flat or falling), signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% for 3 consecutive months AND PAYEMS not increasing YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered periods, or unemployment falls sharply within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months, with no concurrent rise in unemployment, indicates supply-side disruptions that raise input costs and reduce margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA for 4 consecutive months AND UNRATE not rising YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or industrial production rebounds above its MA within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) below 2%, coupled with a simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS, signals a risk of overtightening and deflationary pressure, which historically has been associated with negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day returns in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or CPI rebounds above 2% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) exceeding the concurrent increase in personal income (proxied by GDPC1/PAYEMS ratio) for three consecutive months signals elevated precautionary savings and weak consumption momentum, which tends to precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > (GDPC1 growth / PAYEMS growth) for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or savings growth normalizes within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% for four consecutive months, regardless of GDP growth, signals robust labor market expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered months, or payroll growth decelerates sharply in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) for two consecutive months signals a supply-side recovery without labor market overheating, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month MA AND UNRATE < previous month for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or either INDPRO or UNRATE reverses trend within the next month.
